run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T09:37:52Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend is explained by error spans that are confined to the checkout path: frontend POST /api/checkout -> grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder -> shipping /get-quote (with its client span POST quote). Shipping's own /get-quote spans and its quote client spans carry ERROR, while the quote service's own POST /getquote spans carry no error and both quote pods are ready endpoints. During the burst, quote pod logs show successful quotes only in short bursts at ~:49 each minute (09:37:49, 09:38:49-50, 09:39:49-50, 09:40:49-54 ... 09:45:51), exactly in the gaps after each chaos-mesh NetworkChaos 'Recovered' and before the next 'Applied'. Chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition in namespace chaos-mesh spawned a NetworkChaos every ~60 s from 09:35:54 to 09:45:54, and PodNetworkChaos events name exactly the shipping pod and both quote pods. So the fault originates in that chaos Schedule's repeated network partition between shipping and quote, which makes shipping's quote calls fail and propagates as checkout failures and then frontend 5xx/error spans. All otel-demo pods were Running/Ready with 0 restarts and no Evicted/OOMKilled events, the flagd fault-injection flags do not include a shipping/quote fault, and no NetworkPolicies exist in the namespace; frontend error counters were flat before the partition began and stopped increasing after it. The exact NetworkChaos spec (direction/action/duration) and the alert rule's PromQL could not be read.

claims.text: In the hour ending 09:37:52Z, frontend spans with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR were only on the checkout path: POST /api/checkout = 27.63, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' = 27.63 and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder = 27.63 error spans, with 0 on GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, executing api route /api/cart, /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart and tcp.connect.

Shipping's own server span /get-quote and its client span POST quote both carried STATUS_CODE_ERROR, with identical cumulative values rising from 27 at the 09:38 sample to 279 at the 09:47 sample; the quote service's own spans POST /getquote, calculate-quote and {closure} appear only with STATUS_CODE_UNSET, i.e. quote itself recorded no error spans.

Checkout's HTTP POST and oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error-span counts equal shipping's /get-quote error counts in the same 10-minute window (176.71), while checkout's calls to cart (GetCart/EmptyCart), currency (Convert), payment (Charge) and product catalog (GetProduct) appear only with STATUS_CODE_UNSET; the same error counts also appear on frontend-proxy spans 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress'.

The frontend error-span counter was constant at 1932 in every sample from 09:20 to 09:37, then rose to 2040 (09:38), 2284 (09:40), 2600 (09:44), 2944 (09:46) and 3048 (09:47), and read 3048 in the later samples up to 09:51; this is a sum over all frontend error spans, not a count of failed requests.

In the pre-incident window 08:40-09:20 there were no error spans for frontend, checkout, shipping, frontend-proxy, payment, cart, ad or accounting (all 0), so the frontend error rate was not already deviating before the partition; recommendation alone shows 1.12 pre-existing error spans in that baseline, unrelated to checkout.

Chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition in namespace chaos-mesh emitted a Spawned event once per minute at 09:35:54, 09:36:54, 09:37:54, 09:38:54, 09:39:54, 09:40:54, 09:41:54, 09:42:54, 09:43:54, 09:44:54 and 09:45:54, and PodNetworkChaos events in namespace otel-demo name exactly the pods shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9, quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b and quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt (21 Updated events each).

Each spawned NetworkChaos object (names otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition-nh2wt, -wg96t, -w588w, -r952x, -x4hvd, -m59h5, -sq968, -2c44x, -8h4xd, -xb6sh, -kx8th) shows the sequence Applied -> TimeUp -> Recovered about 55 seconds apart: for example nh2wt Applied 09:35:54 and Recovered 09:36:49, wg96t Applied 09:36:54 and Recovered 09:37:49, w588w Applied 09:37:54 and Recovered 09:38:49, and so on to kx8th Applied 09:45:54.

Quote pod quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b logged 'Calculated quote' only in short bursts at 09:37:49, 09:38:49-50, 09:39:49-50, 09:40:49-54, 09:41:49-51, 09:42:49-52, 09:43:49-52, 09:44:49-52 and 09:45:51 (the earliest line read in 09:30-09:53:40 was 09:37:49), i.e. in the seconds right after each NetworkChaos Recovered and before the next Applied.

The shipping pod logged repeated 'Requesting quote' lines with no error text, and its successful 'Sending Quote'/'Tracking ID Created' lines cluster in the same brief gaps (e.g. 09:39:49-51 and 09:40:49-54); checkout logs show successful '[PlaceOrder]'/'order placed' entries in those gaps as well.

The frontend/checkout/shipping error-span increases over 5-minute windows fell from 279.52/137.39/137.39 at the 09:49 sample to 140.30/70.15/72.85 at 09:50 and 0 for all three at 09:51, so new error spans stopped accumulating by about 09:51.

All 22 pods in otel-demo were Running and Ready with restartCount 0 and start times 09:01:42-09:03:42 (before the incident), including shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9, quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b, quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt, checkout-5dccddf8bb-vz2zd and frontend-675fd7b5c5-d2vwq; the cluster event grouping shows no Evicted, OOMKilling, CrashLoopBackOff, Failed or Unhealthy events for otel-demo pods.

The quote Service Endpoints object lists two ready addresses (100.96.2.155, 100.96.4.53 on port 8080) with no notReadyAddresses, and the shipping Endpoints object lists one ready address (100.96.4.227:8080), so service discovery and pod registration were intact; the query for NetworkPolicies in otel-demo returned an empty list (0 objects).

A flagd feature-flag fault injection on the shipping/quote path was considered and rejected: the flagd-config ConfigMap's demo.flagd.json contains 12 flags (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) with defaultVariant 'off', and none of them targets shipping or quote; the observed failure path is shipping -> quote, not any flagged dependency.

Mechanism hypothesis: each NetworkChaos instance implements a pod-level network partition (traffic drop) between shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9 and the two quote pods, which is why shipping's client span POST quote fails while quote's own spans carry no error and quote logs show successes only in the ~5 s gaps after Recovered. Supporting correlation: the first NetworkChaos Applied is 09:35:54 and the frontend alert starts 09:37:52 with the frontend error counter stepping up between the 09:37 and 09:38 samples; the ~1-2 minute offset between the first Applied event and the first recorded error spans is not explained by the available evidence. The NetworkChaos spec (action, direction, duration, selector) could not be read to confirm the exact action.

Review and suspend the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition in namespace chaos-mesh (and its spawned NetworkChaos instances) if the shipping/quote partition is not an intended experiment, then confirm the frontend error rate and the RequestErrorRate alert clear and that shipping /get-quote spans stop carrying ERROR.

gaps: The NetworkChaos/Schedule object specs could not be read: the chaos-mesh custom resources (NetworkChaos, Schedule, PodNetworkChaos) are not among the kinds this Kubernetes tool exposes, so action, direction, duration and the exact pod selector remain unverified; only their events were available.

list_prometheus_rules for rule_name RequestErrorRate returned no rules, so the alert's exact PromQL expression and the reported current value 1.111 were not verified; the rule may live in an Alertmanager/rule source outside this Prometheus.

The alert's firing or resolved state after 09:53:40Z is unknown; the last observed error increases are at the 09:51 sample and the 5-minute rate instant query at 09:53:40Z returned no series (absence, not proof).

Cluster event capture in the returned data ends at 09:45:54Z, so whether the Schedule kept spawning NetworkChaos objects after that time is unknown; no NetworkChaos event later than 09:45:54 was observed.

Frontend container logs contained no readable lines in 09:30-09:53:40 (lines_read 0), so the frontend-side error text/HTTP status for /api/checkout was not verified; the evidence of frontend failure is its error spans.

No application error log line was found in the shipping pod for the failed quote calls (only 'Requesting quote' without success follow-ups), and checkout logs contain no error text, so the client-side error message (timeout vs connection reset) is unknown.
The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so no deployment or configuration change history could be checked.
next_steps: Inspect the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition and a representative NetworkChaos instance (e.g. otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition-kx8th) with chaos-mesh tooling to confirm the partition direction/targets and whether the schedule is still active.
Retrieve the RequestErrorRate alert rule definition from its actual rule source to confirm which metric/labels produce the reported value 1.111.
Confirm with the team whether the shipping-quote-network-partition experiment was intentionally scheduled during this window; if not, treat it as an unintended fault injection.
After the experiment is stopped, verify that shipping /get-quote spans and frontend POST /api/checkout spans return to STATUS_CODE_UNSET and that quote pod logs show a normal request rate.
